name: Flarum
description: Fast, extensible forum software with a single-page application interface.

envVars.description: Public URL the forum is served from

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      FLARUM_DB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-mysql"
      FLARUM_DB_PASS: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
      FLARUM_URL: {{env.FLARUM_URL}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/app:/flarum/app
      - {{appDataPath}}/assets:/flarum/app/public/assets
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-mysql
  {{serviceName}}-mysql:
    image: mysql:8
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mysql
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: flarum
      MYSQL_USER: flarum
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/mysql:/var/lib/mysql
